gen-fs-panchang-manrope: Confident, expressive lettering in Panchang runs on strokes as steady as a drawn string. Manrope follows with bright, open curve mouths and a modest step from capitals to lowercase.
gen-fs-panchang-work-sans: Steady strokes and generous gaps give Panchang its confident, expressive face up top. Work Sans backs it with tips that never creep toward touching and a mean line set high.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-abeezee: Editorial in attitude, Quilon lets its stroke thickness ebb and flow while ABeeZee keeps terminals finishing well away from the stem. The strongest pull is Quilon's sturdy hairlines against ABeeZee's neon-tube thickness.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-anek-devanagari: Commanding and editorial, Quilon thins its strokes like letters stamped in soft metal, with large open counters throughout. Anek Devanagari earns its keep through open mouths and a tall middle zone.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Anek Gurmukhi gives each small letter a big open counter and generous round curves. Anek Gurmukhi does the patient work of the page, while Quilon takes the commanding, editorial lead.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-anek-latin: Quilon arrives with an editorial, commanding stride, its stroke thickness ebbing and flowing. Anek Latin does the quieter job, with lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals and letters held open, never curled shut.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-anek-malayalam: Editorial and commanding, Quilon keeps its stems and hairlines in a close ratio. Anek Malayalam handles the detail work, keeping capitals barely above lowercase and curves whose tips never touch.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-anek-odia: Anek Odia keeps its rounds unlatched like an open hook, with capitals only slightly taller than the lowercase. Quilon sets the tone; paragraphs in Anek Odia would move along smoothly.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-arimo: Soft and commanding, Quilon swells with the mild give of a worn felt marker. Arimo adds its real strength: a tall mean line and spacious gaps at the ends of rounded letters.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: A calm ebb and flow in stroke thickness marks Quilon, whose large open counters make its display lines feel commanding. Atkinson Hyperlegible sits quietly beneath, with wide-set terminals on its s.
